findings.message: Sources declaration overstates what is bound (sources): specs/content/efmp-301/sources/unit-11.md:15 declares seifert2009 "retrieved and read 2026-09-24; bound excerpt in sources/texts/seifert2009.md" supporting U11-3/U11-4 through Chapter 8 (the teacher-pupil relationship and classroom communication behind the stations' supports; the teacher's communication role and its professional boundaries), but sources/texts/seifert2009.md contains no Chapter 8 section (its ## sections cover Chapters 2,3,4,5,6,7,9,10,11,12 for Units 2-10; verified also at the manifest-preparation commit 6d6236d7), and sources/unit-11.md has no "## Unverifiable sources" declaration. The Chapter 8 support behind U11-3/U11-4 is unverifiable from the bundle while presented as bound, which the G3 rubric treats as a declaration that overstates what it leaves unchecked. Repair: bind the Chapter 8 excerpts (CC BY 3.0; the excerpt header records the book was read 2026-09-24) in sources/texts/seifert2009.md, or restate the row's actual support basis (WHO plus course cross-references) or declare it under "## Unverifiable sources" with retrieval attempts, date and owner authorisation.

MCQ topic spread deviates from the approved blueprint (assessment): the approved blueprint (specs/content/efmp-301/content-spec.md:1296-1297 "MCQs (10): Remember to Apply; spread 5/5 across topics 11.1 to 11.2"; confirmed at specs/content/efmp-301/intake-2/evaluation.md:118-119) requires five MCQs per topic, but docs/semester-1/efmp-301/unit-11/unit-assessment.mdx:44-106 distributes them 7/3: MCQ 1-7 test topic 11.1 material (U11-1 definition and balance, U11-2 signs) and only MCQ 8-10 test topic 11.2 material (U11-4 role); U11-3 (the stations) has no MCQ. The unit's own concept graph (specs/content/efmp-301/concepts/unit-11.md) confirms the mapping. Repair: rebalance two MCQs onto topic 11.2 material (the stations are untested at MCQ level) or amend the blueprint through the spec channel.

ERQ per-topic distribution deviates from the approved blueprint (assessment): content-spec.md:1300-1302 requires "two per topic plus one integrative", but the bank gives topic 11.1's material at most one ERQ (ERQ-1, which is itself the spec's described integrative object: "a described pupil's changed behaviour read through the signs, the environment and the teacher's role limits") while topic 11.2 carries ERQ-2/3/4 and ERQ-5 is the capstone audit. Repair: add or refocus an ERQ on topic 11.1 material (definition, balance, signs) so each topic carries two, keeping one integrative, or amend the blueprint through the spec channel.

Bare-URL link text (accessibility): docs/semester-1/efmp-301/unit-11/topic-01.mdx:175-178 and topic-02.mdx:171-174 use the raw URL as the link text of both Further reading entries (render-inspect flagged 2 bare-URL links per topic). Descriptive link text (source + title) would serve screen-reader and scan-reading users better; the pattern is course-wide, so advisory.

Misconception from the spec list not explicitly rebutted (pedagogy): content-spec.md Unit 11 lists "talking about suicide or sadness plants the idea" among the unit's misconceptions; the unit teaches against it implicitly (topic-01.mdx:98-100 "Treat the talk as real... dismissing it as drama is the costliest move"; the teacher-notes sensitivity rules) but never names the myth itself. Naming it in topic-01's signs discussion would close the gap the spec flagged.
